text_en:
Maintenance Procedure Information System
 | Distribution Companies | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.:
 DB-001-r0a | Equipment:
 Low Voltage Distribution Boxes
Issued to: 
 Distribution Companies
Status: 
Approved
Approval date: 22 
 November 2006 | Procedure:
 Half-Yearly Maintenance 
 (P1-M6)
Next review date: November 
2011
Introduction
This document sets out the maintenance procedures P1 for distribution boxes, which must be carried out every 6 months as indicated above by the code M6, and the initial draft was prepared, discussed, amended and approved by the MPIS coordinators of the electricity distribution companies.
Safety Precautions
Open an approved work order; workers shall carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Fence off the work location and post warning signs.
Wear occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Ensure absence of voltage and apply local earthing.
Open an approved work order; workers shall carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Fence off the work location and post warning signs.
Wear occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Ensure absence of voltage and apply local earthing.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Occupational safety and health equipment.
Numbering machine, terminal crimping machine (press).
Cleaning tools, blower.
Voltage indicator, fuse removal handle.
Occupational safety and health equipment.
Numbering machine, terminal crimping machine (press).
Cleaning tools, blower.
Voltage indicator, fuse removal handle.
Maintenance Steps to be Carried Out
Observe the box level | 1.
Ensure the soundness of the bases | 2.
Check the box paint | 3.
Clean the box | 4.
Check the numbering and name of the box | 5.
Check the numbering and names of the cables / outgoing feeders | 6.
Check the cable entry and exit openings | 7.
Check the box earthing | 8.
Check the switches and fuses | 9.
Check the rated value of the fuses and switches | 10.
Check the fixing of the fuse base and contact points | 11.
Check the soundness of the terminals and their good crimping | 12.
Record in the maintenance card and check the previous maintenance date | 13.
Ensure the box is securely closed | 14.
